name: hamamelis virginiana root bark/stem bark + horse chestnut + strychnos nux-vomica seed
purpose: Purpose* Relieves Symptoms of Internal & External Hemorrhoids: Burning, Itching, Pain, and Swelling
uses: Uses* temporarily relieves symptoms of internal and external hemorrhoids such as: burning itching swelling pain discomfort helps shrink swollen hemorrhoids relieves hemorrhoid symptoms following childbirth
otcwarn: Ask a doctor before use in case of bleeding. Stop use and ask a doctor if symptoms persist for more than 7 days or worsen.
